top_stories.title: Microsoft launches $99 Microsoft 365 E7 with AI-powered Copilot Cowork
top_stories.summary: Microsoft introduced a new $99 Microsoft 365 E7 license, which includes expanded AI features such as Copilot Cowork, integrating advanced generative AI across business productivity apps. This move underscores Microsoft's push to embed AI into enterprise workflows and could reshape business software usage.

top_stories.title: Microsoft announces Copilot Cowork with help from Anthropic — a cloud-powered AI agent that works across M365 apps
top_stories.summary: Microsoft unveiled Copilot Cowork, a new cloud-based AI agent, created in partnership with Anthropic, that integrates with Microsoft 365 apps to enhance productivity and collaboration with advanced generative AI capabilities. The partnership signals Microsoft's deepening investment in external AI expertise and a broader ecosystem approach.

top_stories.title: Amazon holds engineering meeting following AI-related outages [Paywalled]
top_stories.summary: Amazon convened a major engineering meeting after a series of AI-related outages impacted its services, raising concerns about infrastructure reliability as AI systems become more integrated in core business operations. The incident highlights growing operational challenges for enterprise AI deployment.

top_stories.title: Learnings from paying artists royalties for AI-generated art
top_stories.summary: Kapwing shares insights after experimenting with paying royalties to artists for AI-generated art, exploring legal, practical, and ethical challenges in compensating contributors whose work trained AI models. The experience offers an early, concrete look at copyright and payment systems for generative AI art.

top_stories.title: Mark Zuckerberg creating new Applied AI engineering company, reorganises teams
top_stories.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg is reorganising key teams and creating a new applied AI engineering company to accelerate the organisation's AI capabilities, potentially impacting Meta’s product roadmap and industry efforts in applied large language models.
